static_traits.name: Lin Anran
static_traits.social_status: Having several friends for daily chats, but not yet sharing deep unease and Self-doubt with others
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness; no similar psychological problem history in the past; never received psychotherapy/counseling
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly good logicality, capable of self-reflection; emotional tone tends negative, often uses absolutist and self-labeling language (such as 'I am a terrible shopper'); high cooperation with counseling, can honestly discuss experiences.

basic_info.main_problem: I have a habit of excessive online shopping, constantly checking the mirror, feeling people are always looking at me. But I often think the things I buy are all bad products, so I feel I am a terrible shopper, developing low self-esteem and Self-doubt. These feelings have intensified over the months of increased online shopping, especially when receiving packages that do not meet expectations. Every online purchase or mirror check brings negative thoughts and self-criticism.
basic_info.core_demands: These negative thoughts and self-labels are affecting my self-esteem and causing daily distress, so I seek counseling to relieve their impact.

core_beliefs: I am incompetent / have no taste
Must get it right every time to have value
Others will judge me by harsh standards

special_situations.event: After the package arrives, the product's color/size does not match expectations
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If what I buy is not perfect, it proves I have no taste and am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Harsh self-criticism, increases intensity of selecting and comparing, frequent returns and claims
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am just a terrible shopper

special_situations.event: Repeatedly browsing and comparing before ordering, facing a purchase decision
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I should make the right choice every single time, otherwise people will look down on me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Over-researching and comparing, obsessively browsing, procrastinating or impulsively ordering to relieve unease
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I buy wrong, others will think I have no taste

special_situations.event: In public or when looking in the mirror, pays attention to appearance and outfit
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only with perfect appearance/matching will I be accepted and not laughed at
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Frequently checking the mirror, self-monitoring and adjusting my image, avoiding sharing unease with others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are all watching me, judging me

special_situations.event: Thinks of past satisfactory purchase experiences
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One success does not mean I will make good choices; most of the time I will still fail
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Dismissing the importance of positive experiences, continuing to use failure as the dominant evidence
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: That was just good luck; it does not count

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and accepted, seen as someone with taste who makes the right choices
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being judged and humiliated by others; fearing that mistakes expose incompetence and utter worthlessness
defense_goal: Avoiding external blame through preemptive self-criticism
Maintaining a sense of control and safety through high standards and self-monitoring
Avoiding exposing vulnerability to others to reduce the risk of being rejected

object_relations.self_representation: A flawed self, prone to mistakes, needing constant self-correction

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others ask for evidence of 'whether they really are a bad shopper', or when details of purchase failures are discussed
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Experiencing the inquiry as a dismissal of my ability and potential judgment (fearing being blamed or humiliated)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a self-blaming, low tone, repeatedly using 'It is all my fault / I cannot do it', minimizing external factors; speaking slightly fast, finding it hard to pause and consider positive evidence.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the topic of 'whether others are watching/judging me' comes up, or when personal preferences and choices need to be expressed in the session
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Attributing inner harsh self-criticism to others, experiencing it as 'everyone is picking on my flaws' (transference: projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In an uncertain but anxious tone, using 'they' and 'everyone' a lot, attributing tension to outside gazes, avoiding specifying evidence.

manifestations: Although there are friends to chat with daily, not yet sharing deep unease and Self-doubt
Often feels watched and judged by others and keeps psychological distance from people
Replacing genuine connection with self-monitoring and self-blame
outcomes: Avoids expressing vulnerability; support utilization is limited
Fights isolation through excessive online shopping and mirror-checking, which instead worsens the distress

manifestations: Rigid demand for 'making the right choice every time'
Internalizing full responsibility for choice outcomes, finding it hard to tolerate uncertainty
outcomes: Decision pressure and worsening guilt and self-blame
Temporarily relieving anxiety through over-researching / impulsive ordering, forming a vicious cycle

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Internalizes a rule of 'must choose right every time' in shopping and appearance
Demanding of oneself with 'should/must' to achieve the perfect purchase
Takes others' possible standards as the basis for self-judgment

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Frequently looks in the mirror, blames oneself, and carefully corrects appearance and choices
In sessions, tends to look for the 'correct answer' and is careful about self-expression
Not sharing vulnerability with friends to avoid possible judgment

positive_force: Willing to seek help and start counseling
Having some reality-testing ability, able to identify external factors (e.g. lighting, size differences)
Acknowledges exceptional experiences of successful purchases
Has basic social support (a few friends for daily communication)
Willing to try new coping strategies when about to place an order (reality testing)
negative_force: Black-and-white thinking and overgeneralization reinforcing the sense of failure
Overly concerned with others' gazes; mind-reading tendency
Using excessive online shopping and frequent mirror-checking as maladaptive coping
Body image unease and financial stress anxiety

antecedent: Browsing shopping platforms, stimulated by promotions
When in low mood or anxious
Expecting to improve self-image through purchasing
Developing a strong compensatory buying urge after receiving packages that do not meet expectations
target_behavior.core_reason: Anxiety triggered by impaired self-esteem and body image unease, seeking external confirmation and a sense of control through buying; catastrophizing and personalizing attributions of 'buying wrong = failure' maintain the behavior
target_behavior.function: Relieving anxiety and uncertainty in the short term, gaining anticipation and a sense of control, seeking external recognition
target_behavior.consequence: Financial stress, worsening sense of failure and Self-doubt, forming a vicious cycle

antecedent: Before going out or when in public places
When shopping or trying on new items
When the thought of being watched by others arises
target_behavior.core_reason: Fear of others' judgment and body image unease, trying to gain a sense of safety through self-monitoring
target_behavior.function: Temporarily reducing uncertainty and anxiety, seeking reassurance and a sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: Rising self-focus and tension, reinforcing attention to flaws, further weakening self-esteem

target_behavior.behavior: Self-deprecating and labeling speech (such as 'I am a terrible shopper')
antecedent: Receiving products that do not match expectations
Feels pressured when needing to make purchase decisions
target_behavior.core_reason: Internalized harsh standards and overgeneralization of failure, personalizing negative outcomes as 'I cannot do it'
target_behavior.function: Preemptively blames oneself to avoid external accusations, maintaining a surface sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: Negative self-schemas reinforced, increased low mood and avoidance/impulsive behaviors
